# Supplementary Methods

## S1. Carbon Cloth Functionalization Protocol

Carbon cloth substrates (WOS1009, CeTech) were sequentially washed in acetone, ethanol, and deionized water under ultrasonic agitation for 20 minutes each.
Following solvent cleaning, electrodes were exposed to air plasma for 5 minutes at 100 W to introduce oxygen-containing functional groups.
Amine functionalization was achieved by immersing oxidized substrates in a 2% (v/v) ethanolic solution of (3-aminopropyl)triethoxysilane (APTES) at 60 °C for 4 hours.
The treated substrates were rinsed thoroughly with absolute ethanol and cured at 110 °C for 1 hour under vacuum.
